original_record.question:
Kelly had a paper ribbon of $27 \mathrm{~cm}$ long. She divided it into four rectangles of different size and drew two segments both of which connected the centres of the two adjacent rectangles (see the picture). Find the sum of lengths of the two segments.
<image1>
options: The number depends on the division
original_record.subject: transformation geometry

inventory: One long narrow rectangle split into four unequal rectangles; two horizontal segments connect the centers of rectangles1–2 and3–4; four filled endpoint dots; no numerical labels in original.

answer_review.reason: Each segment is half the sum of its pair of widths; combined length is27/2=13.5cm, optionB.
